properties.mlm:pretrained_source: Masked-autoencoder pretraining on 4.2 million NASA HLS 4-timestep, 30 m time series

mlm:input.name: sentinel-2-l2a-time-series
mlm:input.description: Six Sentinel-2 L2A reflectance bands used as a CDSE proxy for the HLS input: B02 (Blue), B03 (Green), B04 (Red), B8A (Narrow NIR), B11 (SWIR 1) and B12 (SWIR 2), plus SCL for cloud masking.

mlm:output.name: embedding
mlm:output.description: 768-dimensional per-pixel embedding from the frozen Prithvi-EO-2.0 100M-TL encoder.

processing.lineage: Per-pixel embeddings inferred by the frozen Prithvi-EO-2.0 100M-TL encoder from CDSE Sentinel-2 L2A time series resampled to 30 m. Sentinel-2 L2A substitutes for the HLS input used in pretraining, with scene-level cloud filtering and SCL masking; embeddings can therefore differ from HLS-based inference. The encoder is exported to ONNX with PyTorch 2.7.1 and run through ONNX Runtime by the openEO user-defined process prithvi_eo_v2_embeddings.

publications.citation: Szwarcman, D. et al. (2024) 'Prithvi-EO-2.0: A Versatile Multi-Temporal Foundation Model for Earth Observation Applications', arXiv:2412.02732

weights.title: Prithvi-EO-2.0 100M-TL ONNX encoder
weights.description: ONNX export of the frozen Prithvi-EO-2.0 100M-TL encoder with four-frame, six-band Sentinel-2 input.
